buildMethod: Standard optimized pending UI build, then matching pinned production links reusing hash-frozen normal core objects. Literal local native core include closure excludes the final UI-only header change. Seven matching backend fixtures; at most two compilers.
proof: Retry is explicit and enabled only after proven rejection and producer-ticket completion.
The stable presentation session follows new job/message identities while retaining the same request token and one private request handler.
Retry and cancellation use separate joined workers; cancellation follows the current generation and completion is shared with the original presentation.
The retry presentation claim remains until binding or cancellation cleanup, preventing normal offer polling from opening another confirmation.
The actual light/dark UI keeps edits and the same HWND across failed admission, Retry and Download Later.

The production warm browser test blocks its own catalog temp path, observes rejection with zero history rows, removes the empty barrier, clicks Retry in the same dialog, then fully downloads and decodes the selected video.
limits: The retry feature applies to eligible new browser video admissions. Direct audio, existing-record/duplicate and refresh workflows retain their original fallback.
Failures before a prepared identity remain uncertain; expired-token/browser-refresh UX and complete retry error detail are still open.

The cold/warm browser tests use controlled isolated Edge/native fixtures. One production failure/retry/complete-download case verifies selected HLS MP4; other formats, the personal installed browser and concurrent browser retry races need qualification.
Cancellation-worker independence and close/join ordering have gated fixture coverage; full Windows session-end/crash acceptance remains open.
Accepted Start/Later persistence still runs on the UI path; cold-frame startup overlap and fresh IDM timing comparisons remain open. No overall speedup or IDM parity is claimed.
artifactDisposition: Three verified downloaded payloads removed individually after qualification: 19,680,228 logical bytes. Profiles and native outputs retained on C; no recursive deletion or new media-tool copies.
